reasoning: Minnie claims to have adjusted an internal lamp at 6:44 according to the synchronized service clock. The alcove was locked at 6:38 and the actual 6:31 installation had an external lamp and open cradle, not the internal cabinet lamp in the superseded proposal. Several people make impossible late-entry claims, and several early visitors describe the nonexistent cabinet. Minnie combines both forms of false detail and admits earlier business around the unmonitored donor salon. Her lighting and payment conflict supply a credible motive. This is a stronger invented-cover-story inference than a direct proof of poisoning.
